title: CS61C: Great Ideas in Computer Architecture

unit.title: C Systems Kickoff: A Verified Integer Index
unit.scope: Build, test, and explain one small C11 library and command-line program, with emphasis on contracts, ownership, defensive parsing, reproducible builds, and evidence.
learning_objectives: Translate a familiar lower-bound algorithm into a precise C interface contract.
Manage allocation, ownership, integer bounds, and cleanup without undefined behavior.
Separate reusable library logic from parsing and command-line policy.
Create deterministic tests and record compiler and sanitizer evidence.
Explain how C source becomes an executable and where the program's data lives.

unit_completion_requires: All required learner outputs are present in the learner attempt.
The project builds and its deterministic tests pass under validator-controlled commands.
Validator-controlled memory and undefined-behavior checks report no defect on the exercised paths.
The implementation, engineering evidence, and comprehension responses meet the independent examiner rubric.
completion_policy.on_pass: Mark kickoff_c_index_v1 complete; retain the course as in progress and require separately prepared and validated later units.
completion_policy.on_fail: Retain the failed attempt and its evidence; do not mark either the unit or course complete.
